notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.21.7
Major fix in stacking suite when you run Remove Satellite Trails in Light Calibration. This was leading to dark or light satellite trails for some users in the final master light. This has been resolved. Other bug fixes in Stacking Suite, Plate Solver, and SSSC

V1.21.6
Removed the necessity of hold Alt when dragging and dropping icons to get them to function. Updated satellite removal in stacking suite to support more systems by forcing NaN values where the satellite trail was. Other bug fixes.

V1.21.5
Big Update:
Metadata from fits/xisf headers now get written and read from other formats like tiff, png, etc. This means your astrometric solutions should even save across image formats.

Major contributions from user GRM for ram and vram usage

Major updates to Stacking Suite including the use of Sets in Image Integration. Allowing you to integration multiple targets to their own reference frames, perfect for batch stacking multiple targets, mosaics, etc. Calibration pipeline streamlined under the hood. Execution Monitor bug fixes.

Star Alignment major optimizations for greatly improved speed in image registration processes.

Many other bug fixes throughout.
